technology_name: A HYPERMETROPIC CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL NETWORK DEVICE FOR SMALL SIZE OBJECT DETECTION AND A METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Computer Vision Model / Embedded Edge AI Device
problem_solved: Standard deep learning object detection configurations drop accuracy matrices sharply when extracting tiny pixel clusters, leading to missing detections in remote sensing fields.
description: An advanced Hypermetropic Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture optimized with shallow feature extraction channels and combined depth-wise/channel-wise convolution blocks to amplify tiny semantic representations without processing overhead.
applications: Autonomous drone search-and-rescue arrays, aerial satellite military surveillance, micro-defect automated factory sortation rigs, and robotic tracking lenses.
